IntVectorProperty.name: Run
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: The values of this property sets the case **Run** number.

StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the **User** for the UAL Database.

StringVectorProperty.name: Device
StringVectorProperty.label: Device
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the **Device** for the UAL Database.

StringVectorProperty.name: LoadIDS
StringVectorProperty.label: Read from IDS
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the IDS from which the grid geometry and plasma state are to be read.

StringVectorProperty.name: IDSPlasmaStateSource
StringVectorProperty.label: (optional) Read quantities from
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the IDS from which the **plasma state quantities** are to be read in case when the grid geometry in e.g. edge_profiles IDS corresponds also to quantities in edge_sources. In case this option is not set, the plasma state is taken from the IDS specified in the main 'Read from IDS' option.

IntVectorProperty.name: EdgeSourcesSourceID
IntVectorProperty.label: .source(#)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the **edge_sources.source(:)** IDS **structure array index**. Python notation (0, 1, 2, ...). Default value = 0. NOTE: This same value is taken into account for both, grid geometry and plasma state data.

IntVectorProperty.name: EdgeTransportModelID
IntVectorProperty.label: .model(#)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the **edge_transport.model(:)** IDS structure **array index**. Python notation (0, 1, 2, ...). Default value = 0. NOTE: This same value is taken into account for both, **grid geometry** and **plasma state**.

IntVectorProperty.name: GridGGDslice
IntVectorProperty.label: .grid_ggd(#)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: The values of this property sets the **Grid GGD time slice** to point to the wanted **grid geometry data** for specific time slice. Python notation (0, 1, 2, ...). Default value = 0.

IntVectorProperty.name: GGDslice
IntVectorProperty.label: .ggd(#)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: The values of this property sets the **GGD time slice** to point to the wanted **plasma state quantities** for specific time slice. Python notation (0, 1, 2, ...). Default value = 0.

StringVectorProperty.name: GridForm
StringVectorProperty.label: Represent grid as
StringVectorProperty.Documentation:
This property specifies the form in which the data is represented.
- **Grid subsets**: the representation of the geometry and quantities as **grid subsets** (in IDS the **ggd_grid(:).grid_subset** node must contain appropriate data). This one constructs a set of blocks, each block containing **single grid subset** (collection of n-dimensional elements of a single type e.g. vertices, quads etc.) as **Unstructured Grid**. SOLPS-ITER and JINTRAC are one of such codes that use this feature.
- **Single grid**: representation of the geometry and plasma state quantities as a **single Unstructured Grid**, combining grid elements (found in **ggd_grid(:).space(:).objects_per_dimension(:)...**) into a single **vtkUnstructuredGrid object**. This feature is intended for grid descriptions which is **NOT** divided into grid subsets (NOTE: it can still be used also with IDSs which contain grid subsets. In this case the major grid subsets 'nodes', 'edges' and 'cells' will be combined into a single vtkUnstructuredGrid). A good example for such cases are IDSs which contain meshes with corresponding values.

IntVectorProperty.name: ReadAllTimeSlicesCheckBox
IntVectorProperty.label: Read all time slices
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When activated, on the press of the **Apply** button vtkMultiBlocks for all available (GGD) time slices will be created NOTE: due to non-trivial and limited solutions for plugins, the VTM files get written to **/tmp** directory and then are read to ParaView by the plugin.

IntVectorProperty.name: IDSListCheckBox
IntVectorProperty.label: Show list of available IDS Shot/Run cases
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: This checkbox opens the list of available IDSs for specified user.

StringVectorProperty.name: ShotRunList
StringVectorProperty.label: IDS List
